hints: Find the coefficient of $x^3$ in $(1-3x)^6$ using $\binom{6}{3}(-3)^3$.
Find the coefficient of $x^3$ in $(1+ax)^5$ using $\binom{5}{3}a^3$.
Equate the sum to $100$ and solve for $a$.
walkthrough:
Find the $x^3$ terms from both binomial expansions:
$$\text{In } (1 - 3x)^6:\quad \binom{6}{3}(1)^3(-3x)^3 = 20 \times (-27x^3) = -540x^3$$
$$\text{In } (1 + ax)^5:\quad \binom{5}{3}(1)^2(ax)^3 = 10a^3 x^3$$

Equate the sum of the coefficients to the given value of $100$:
$$-540 + 10a^3 = 100$$
